exam.title: DN42 Certified Network Associate (Practice Exam)
exam.description: Passing this exam helps you to pass the DCNA certification easier, it tests a candidate's knowledge and skills related to network fundamentals, routing and switching, IP connectivity, BGP configuration, connectivity troubleshooting, and automation and programmability.

question.description: An engineer is configuring router R2 in autonomous system 65002 to control the propagation of the prefix 192.0.2.0/24, which R2 learns from router R1 via an eBGP session. The engineer applies an inbound route map that sets the well-known community NO_ADVERTISE on this prefix. R2 has three fully established iBGP peers inside AS 65002 and one additional eBGP peer in AS 65003. Assuming no other filtering is configured, to which peers will R2 advertise the 192.0.2.0/24 prefix? (Choose one.)

options.option: All iBGP and eBGP peers, because NO_ADVERTISE only prevents the prefix from being readvertised toward the originating AS
All three iBGP peers only
The eBGP peer in AS 65003 only
All iBGP and eBGP peers, but with the community attribute stripped from the updates
No BGP peers at all; the prefix remains in R2's local BGP table but is not advertised to any peer
No BGP peers at all; the prefix remains in R2's local BGP table but is not advertised to any peer

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer is investigating a reachability issue in an experimental BGP overlay network. ICMPv6 echo requests from the local router to fdea:6e46:2f1c::1 time out, and traceroute dies several hops into the path. The engineer verifies that the iBGP session to i-bzip9 is established, that no ACLs are blocking ICMPv6, and the rp_filter kernel parameter is set to 0 for all interfaces. Which statement best explains why the pings fail? (Choose one.)

options.option: A link-local address cannot be used as the BGP next hop for a unicast prefix.
The MED value of 100 prevents the route from being installed into the routing table.
The entry is a ghost route, and traffic is blackholed along the phantom path.
The community (64511,33) instructs downstream autonomous systems to filter the prefix.
The asterisk (*) indicates the route is valid but not selected as best, so it is not used for forwarding.
The entry is a ghost route, and traffic is blackholed along the phantom path.

options.option: DNS
DHCP

question.description: Refer to the exhibits. An engineer must configure BGP sessions with several neighbors across a newly deployed overlay network. The engineer has installed BIRD 2.x on a Linux router and has provisioned a single WireGuard interface named wg-dn42 to carry all neighbor adjacencies toward three different ASes in a private peering environment. The underlay network is fully operational: all three remote endpoints answer ICMP echo requests from the router's public address, the listening UDP port 51820 is permitted by the firewall, and NTP is synchronized across all devices. The engineer also has verified that all the pubkeys are correct exchanged and AllowedIPs are configured with 10.127.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14, fd00::/8. Which two configuration changes will allow all three BGP sessions to reach the Established state? (Choose two.)

options.option: Reduce the BGP keepalive interval to 10 seconds and the hold timer to 30 seconds on all three neighbor statements.
Configure a unique UDP listening port for each peer entry under the wg-dn42 interface, and permit the corresponding ports on the firewall.
Migrate each neighbor onto its own dedicated WireGuard interface.
Set PersistentKeepalive = 25 on each peer of the wg-dn42 interface.
Add 224.0.0.5 and 224.0.0.6 to the AllowedIPs of each WireGuard peer.
Assign at least one link-local or ULA address to each WireGuard tunnel interface.
Upgrade the local BIRD installation from 2.x to 3.x to match the BIRD release version running on the remote peers.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An administrator is troubleshooting a Linux-based BGP router in an experimental internetwork where asymmetric routing between upstream providers is common. tcpdump shows that ICMP echo requests sourced in the downstream AS enter the router through wg-peer and are forwarded out wg-up1, while the corresponding ICMP echo replies arrive on wg-up2 and are silently discarded instead of being forwarded toward the downstream AS. The FIB contains a valid route to the destination, IPv4 forwarding is enabled, and no packet-filter rule matches the traffic. Which action allows the ICMP replies to be forwarded to the downstream AS? (Choose one.)

options.option: Set net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter and the per-interface rp_filter of every neighbor-facing interface to 1.
Add an iptables rule to the FORWARD chain that accepts ICMP echo-reply packets arriving on wg-up2.
Advertise all prefixes to both upstream providers with identical MED and AS-path length so that return paths become symmetric.
Set net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter and the per-interface rp_filter of every neighbor-facing interface to 0.
Raise the values of net.ipv4.icmp_msgs_per_sec and net.ipv4.icmp_msgs_burst.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An administrator must configure an eBGP session between two routers in a experimental overlay network. Both routers run BIRD 3.2.0 and are interconnected by a point-to-point tunnel link. The BGP protocol defined in BIRD configuration uses the IPv6 link-local addresses of the tunnel interfaces. To speed up the deployment, the administrator builds the configuration for the second router by copying a working BGP template from the first router and updating only the interface and address statements. After the BIRD daemon is reloaded, the administrator noticed that BIRD rejects it with the error shown in the exhibit. It is confirmed that the multihop option is not configured on either router, and both routers can ping each other's link-local address across the tunnel. Which action resolves the issue? (Choose one.)

options.option: BIRD 3.x enables multihop by default on eBGP sessions that traverse overlay tunnel interfaces, so they must downgrade to BIRD 2.x.
The link-local neighbor addresses must be replaced with global unicast addresses.

A direct (single-hop) BGP session cannot be established over a L3 point-to-point tunnel; the overlay must be rebuilt over a Layer 2 tunneling technology (such as VXLAN or L2TP) so that both routers share a common bridge domain.
Go check if the AS numbers configured on both sides are identical.
Force BIRD to establish a single-hop BGP session by adding `direct;` directive to the configuration.
Enable the "extended nexthop" option in BIRD configuration.

question.description: An engineer is designing a new multi-area OSPF deployment for an enterprise network. The planned topology consists of a backbone area and several non-backbone areas, and one remote area can reach the backbone only by transiting another non-backbone area. Which requirement must the engineer consider in the design? (Choose one.)

options.option: The OSPF router ID must match an IPv4 address assigned to a physical interface.
The OSPF router ID must match an IPv4 address assigned to a loopback interface.
The OSPF router ID must be unique throughout the OSPF routing domain.
The OSPF router ID must be unique only within each area the router belongs to.
Every OSPF area must connect to the backbone area through a direct Ethernet link.
An ABR maintains a single link-state database shared by all areas it connects.

question.description: An engineer is designing BGP for an new enterprise-owned internetwork. The design includes eBGP sessions to two upstream service providers and an iBGP full mesh between the internal routers, with some iBGP peers separated by multiple routed hops. Which requirement must the engineer consider in the design? (Choose one.)

options.option: The BGP router ID must be unique across all BGP autonomous systems.
The BGP router ID must match an IPv4 address assigned to a loopback interface.
The BGP router ID must match an IPv4 address assigned to a physical interface.
The BGP router ID must not match any IPv4 address assigned to a physical interface or loopback interface.
eBGP sessions may be established between non-directly connected routers.

question.description: An engineer is designing the internal BGP topology for a single autonomous system. Which of the following concerns must the engineer take into consideration? (Choose one.)

options.option: An iBGP speaker advertises routes learned from one iBGP peer to all remaining iBGP peers.
An non-RR iBGP speaker does not advertise routes learned from one iBGP peer to any another iBGP peer.
A route reflector reflects routes learned from a non-client peer to the other non-client peers.
A route reflector always rewrites the next-hop attribute of reflected routes to its own loopback address.
A route reflector always rewrites the next-hop attribute of reflected routes to the address assigned on the client-facing interface.
All route reflector must be fully meshed with every other route collector.

question.description: An engineer is joining the DN42 experimental network and must plan IPv4 addressing for the registering AS. The network is a homelab with three servers and one router. Which action is coherent with the discipline of the address management policy of the registry? (Choose one.)

options.option: Request a /24 allocation to accommodate future growth and to simplify reverse DNS delegation.

Register an inetnum object for a /27 or smaller prefix via a registry pull request, verifying that the parent block carries an open policy and has no overlap with the allocated blocks, and prefer IPv6 for peering wherever possible.
Begin announcing an unused-looking prefix from 172.20.0.0/14 immediately, as per RFC1918, no formal reigstration is needed for using the reserved address space.
Announce a publicly routable /24 into DN42 instead, since globally routable prefixes has higher precedence over the RFC1918 prefixes in DN42.
Assign a dedicated DN42 IPv4 address to every physical interface, container, and VM to achieve the full utilization of the IPv4 address allocation.
Request a /24 or larger block in a single application to mitigate address fragmentation and to reduce the administration overheads.
Request additional IPv4 allocations in advance, just because a surging node count entitles the network to more space, regardless of demonstrated usage.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure RFC 2317 classless in-addr.arpa reverse DNS for the 172.20.143.16/28 allocation in DN42. The CNAME records in the parent zone is already in position and can be correctly resolved. A few addresses failed to resolve their PTR records at nearly all public recursors. Which action must the engineer take to restore resolution for the affected address? (Choose one.)

options.option: Change the owner name of the second record to 18.16/28.143.20.172.in-addr.arpa. so that every PTR record resides inside the delegated subzone.
Change the owner name of the first record to 17.143.20.172.in-addr.arpa. so that both records follow the parent-zone naming convention.
Request a full /24 allocation from the registry, because classless delegation cannot carry PTR records for individual addresses.
Abandon reverse DNS for this allocation, because RFC 1918 address space cannot be delegated within in-addr.arpa.
Establish a lot more full-table BGP peerings so that more recursive resolvers can reach the authoritative nameserver.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must investigate a connectivity issue between router BAW-G01 and destination host 172.22.155.161. The mtr output shows the results of the probe packets sent toward the destination. To redact sensitive information, a part of CLI output has been dictionary-substituted. Which statement is correct? (Choose one.)

options.option: The destination host resides in AS4242420003.
Packets destined to 172.22.155.161 are looping between AS4242420002 and AS4242420003.
The latency increase at hop 3 indicates congestion on the link toward host4.example.com.
Probe packets are being rate-limited by the routers beyond hop 4.
AS4242420002 is the only transit AS along the path to the destination.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must look into a BGP route advertisement issue. It is reported from more than one of their neighbors that bogon routes are being advertised by this router. Which of the following statement best explain the issue? (Choose one.)

options.option: The roa_check() function validates against bgp_path.last, so only routes originated by the local AS can be rejected.
The first if statement accepts or rejects every route, so the ROA check is never run.
Blackhole routes fail the is_valid_network() check and are rejected before the ROA check.
Replace the single equal sign `=` with double equal sign `==`, as `=` is use for assigning value to a variable.
The roa_flap_v4 ROA table must be empty, causing all routes to pass ROA validation.
Because the indentation is wrong and the BIRD daemon rejected the configuration.

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. A engineer must experiment OSPF configuration with BIRD on Linux in a lab environment. The WireGuard tunnel intern-4 to the peer is up and running, but `birdc s p` shows that the state of the OSPF protocol is still Alone. Which of the following action best address the issue? (Choose one.)

options.option: Remove type ptp from the interface block.
Ensure that 224.0.0.5/32 and 224.0.0.6/32 is in the the peer's AllowedIPs on both sides.
No action is needed, the Alone state means the protocol is already up and running.
No action is needed since the protocol take time to negotiate before reach the running state.
Set persistent-keepalive to 25 to make the wg tunnel more resistant to the interference of NAT.
